dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (II)
dialogues.text: "...Why come crying to me? 'Please make me some slimming tea'... Hmph! Wild beasts never change, I see! Don't you know that a human form created by adeptal energy can never gain weight...?"

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (II)
dialogues.text: "...And that fish, going along with the whole affair and begging me with a smile despite knowing the truth full well..."

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Text (II)
dialogues.text: "...I agreed. I'll just make it. Who knows? One day, it may be useful for the mortals..."
